title: Attribute
description: A single attribute master data entry, parsed into Attribute (lib/domain/master_data/attribute.dart). One file per attribute, under assets/data/attributes/.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by other data and code, and looked up in the app's localization resources for display text.

index.description: Display order in the UI, independent of the entry's position in this file.

resistantToIds.description: Ids of attributes this attribute is resistant to (takes reduced damage from). Empty/omitted if not yet determined.

weakToIds.description: Ids of attributes this attribute is weak to (takes increased damage from). Empty/omitted if not yet determined.
